decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost complement to the core flooring range. With industry turnover growing and the firm hiring, it has slack and no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of the resources.
Maintenance oil is closely tied to the firm's oiled-floor offer and supports customer relationships. It needs few resources, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
The care product fits the maintenance portfolio. It overlaps slightly with the oil and soap, which raises the chance of portfolio pruning, but satisfactory overall performance argues for keeping it.
A moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory that installers expect alongside floor systems. It adds to the system sale at little cost.
The high-density foam underlay complements the underlay line. With performance at or above aspiration, there is no pressure for problemistic search that would lead to dropping it.
Oak parquet is the firm's core offering and central to its established business. It is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
